name: Head of Bazil Thredd
summary: Warden Thelwater demands proof that the Stockade uprising has been crushed. The severed head of Bazil Thredd is meant to show that the rebellion's leader is dead and Defias control of Stormwind's prison has ended.

sections.title: Proof of Treason's End
sections.body: Bazil Thredd led the uprising in the Stockade beneath Stormwind City. From his cell block, he directed the riots with the help of loyal Defias inmates. Warden Thelwater distrusts outsiders and struggles to keep order. He demands Thredd's head as proof that the ringleader is dead and to test the adventurer's allegiance to Stormwind.

faq.q: Who wants the Head of Bazil Thredd?
aliases: where to turn in thredd head
faq.answer: Warden Thelwater, at the Stockade entrance, demands Bazil Thredd's head. He wants proof that the ringleader is dead before sharing what he knows about Thredd's conspirators.
Bazil Thredd was a high-ranking member of the Defias Brotherhood, imprisoned beneath Stormwind. When the prisoners revolted, he took charge and coordinated the uprising from the eastern cell block.
Bazil Thredd is in the eastern wing of the Stockade, at the far end of the block in a central cell. Defias inmates loyal to him guard the cell.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Thredd's severed head calms immediate panic in the capital and proves the crown's justice can reach the rebellious Stockade.
